name: Oc nui
summary: Snails that live in the limestone crevices and feed on forest leaves. Eat them from April to August, when the meat is thick.
howToEat: Eat them in season, April to August.
where: The limestone hills, April to August.
seoDescription: Ninh Bình limestone snails, which feed on forest leaves and are thickest from April to August.
